American Sign Language — Real Expressions

📸 Real ASL Signs & Expressions

Explore authentic photographic ASL signs. Each card includes authentic handshape, location, and motion guidance. Tap to hear the pronunciation!

EXPRESSIONS / COMMON SIGNS

How to keep the sign: Look at the photo, copy the hand shape and direction, keep your wrist relaxed, and hold the position clearly in front of the camera. For moving signs, follow the arrow/motion shown in the card. Tap a card to hear the word.

A TO Z ALPHABET SIGNS

How to make letters: Study the authentic handshape photo and finger arrangement for each letter from A to Z. Tap any letter card to hear it spoken aloud!
